full_judgment: The complainant opposite party on 5.2.1996 filed a petition of complaint against the accused petitioners before the Nalishi Adalat, Kha Anchal Satkhira alleging offence under section 500 of the Penal Code stating inter alia, that the accused persons are dishonest and tier. On the other hand the complainant is honest and a man of respectable family. The complainant served out side the country for about 18 years and in the year 1972 he completed graduation course from Soviet Defence Ministry and his wife is a school teacher having master decree, the son-in-law of the complainant is a Class-1 Officer and his son is a student of College and the complainant has prestige and position in the society. The accused persons with intent to harass and injure the complainant on 21.01.1994 filed a false case in Shatkhira Police Station under sections 427/447/379 of the Penal Code alleging that the complainant caused damage to the `Ghatla' of pond and theft away valuables about Tk.10,000/- and also incurred loss to the tune of Tk.6000/- but the local Commissioner and some other persons in a statement stated that no such occurrence took place and subsequently on 20.08.95 the complainant was acquitted from the case and in the said judgment while the learned Magistrate acquitted the complainant observes something against the present accused i.e. the said complainant. It is further stated that the accused persons filed the aforesaid case against the complainant with a view that the complain-ant could not erect house and after failure in the case, the accused persons on 24.04.1994 became successful in canceling the bail of the present complainant and the accused persons disclosed that they have been able to put the thief in custody and they distributed sweets to the neighbours by saying that you take sweet on the account that the thief has got punishment and in this way the accused persons defamed the complainant in the society. On 02.02.1996 when the complainant had been passing katia Sarkarpara main road then he found the accused No.2 and while the complainant had been crossing the accused No.2 then loudly said that all of you be aware thief Asaraf Uddin is going and also uttered “ওয়াক থু-ওয়াক থু” and thus the complainant has been defamed.
